flashcards.back: The ratio opposite over hypotenuse for an angle in a right-angled triangle: in the 3-4-5 triangle, sin theta = 3/5 = 0.6 (the SOH part of the card).
The ratio adjacent over hypotenuse for an angle in a right-angled triangle: in the 3-4-5 triangle, cos theta = 4/5 = 0.8 (the CAH part of the card).
The ratio opposite over adjacent for an angle in a right-angled triangle: in the 3-4-5 triangle, tan theta = 3/4 = 0.75 (the TOA part of the card).
The longest side of a right-angled triangle, across from the right angle: length 5 in the 3-4-5 triangle.
The side across from the angle you are working with: length 3 for angle theta in the 3-4-5 triangle.
The side next to the angle you are working with, other than the hypotenuse: length 4 for angle theta in the 3-4-5 triangle.
The rule a / sin A = b / sin B, linking each side of any triangle with the sine of its opposite angle, used when there is no right angle.
Opposite and adjacent swap places under pressure. Always read TOA: tan is opposite over adjacent. For the 3-4-5 triangle that means tan theta = 3/4 = 0.75, never 4/3.

flashcards.front: For the same 3-4-5 triangle, what is tan theta?
In the 3-4-5 triangle, angle theta has opposite side 3 and hypotenuse 5. What is sin theta?

items.answer: a / sin A = b / sin B, so 4 / sin 30 degrees = b / sin 60 degrees. Then b = (4 x sin 60 degrees) / sin 30 degrees = (4 x 0.8660) / 0.5, so b is about 6.93.
items.prompt: In triangle ABC, side a = 4 is opposite angle A = 30 degrees, and angle B = 60 degrees. Use the sine rule to find side b, showing your working.

items.answer: The sine rule links each side with the sine of its opposite angle, so it needs no right angle - a known side and its opposite angle form a complete pair that unlocks the other sides.
items.prompt: In one or two sentences: why does the sine rule work for a triangle with no right angle when SOH CAH TOA does not?

items.answer: The sine rule: a / sin A = b / sin B
items.prompt: A triangle has no right angle. Which rule finds an unknown side from a known side and two known angles?

items.answer: SOH: sin = opposite / hypotenuse. CAH: cos = adjacent / hypotenuse. TOA: tan = opposite / adjacent. So cos theta = 4/5 = 0.8.
items.prompt: Write out the SOH CAH TOA card in full, and use it to state cos theta for the 3-4-5 triangle.
